description: This file is a JavaScript module that scrapes recipe data from seriouseats.com web pages. It exports a function that fetches and parses recipe details such as name, ingredients, instructions, image, tags, and timing information.

methods.name: seriousEats
methods.description: Main function that takes a URL, fetches the webpage, and extracts recipe data if the URL is from seriouseats.com.

methods.name: regularRecipe
methods.description: Helper function that parses the HTML content to extract recipe details and populate the Recipe object.
